featured_reviews.name: CHETAN VEJANI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jungle Juice at Mahaveer Nagar, Kandivali is truly a fantastic place for anyone who loves fresh and healthy beverages. The quality of juices, smoothies, shakes, and other drinks is excellent, and you can genuinely taste the freshness in every sip. The ingredients feel premium, the flavors are rich and natural, and the presentation is always appealing. I was especially impressed by how well they maintain hygiene and cleanliness, which adds a lot to the overall experience.

The staff is polite, friendly, and provides quick service, making every visit pleasant. Whether you want a refreshing fruit juice, a nutritious smoothie, or a delicious thick shake, this place has a great variety to choose from. The taste is consistently good, and the quality remains the same every time, which is something I really appreciate.

The ambiance is also nice and welcoming, making it a perfect spot to stop by for a healthy refreshment. In an area like Mahaveer Nagar, Jungle Juice stands out as a reliable and enjoyable destination for quality drinks. Highly recommended for anyone looking for freshness, taste, and great service all in one place. Will definitely visit again!

featured_reviews.name: Nishit Kheradia
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Fresh Press is a juice brand outlet that not only serves up delicious and healthy drinks but also supports their staff members, which is truly admirable. I had the opportunity to try three of their menu items - the mix berry smoothie bowl, KitKat milkshake, and all-in juice, and here are my thoughts:

The Fresh Press's Mix Berry Smoothie Bowl and it did not disappoint. The blend of fresh berries, bananas, and yogurt made for a delicious and nutritious breakfast option. The smoothie bowl had a satisfying crunch and sweetness.

Next up was the KitKat milkshake, and as a chocolate lover, I was excited to try it. The milkshake was rich and creamy, with a generous amount of KitKat pieces blended in. It's definitely a treat that I would recommend for anyone with a sweet tooth.

Finally, I tried the all-in juice, which was made with a combination of fruits including pineapple, watermelon, Apple and more 2 items. The blend of fruits made it a healthy and nutritious option, but it didn't sacrifice on taste. Overall, a great option for those looking for a healthier drink choice.

Overall, my experience at The Fresh Press was great. The staff was friendly and welcoming. I would definitely recommend this juice brand outlet to anyone looking for a tasty and healthy drink or snack option, while also supporting a good cause.

featured_reviews.name: Piff
featured_reviews.review_text:
Being from Wisconsin, I finished my entire liter of ice water within thirty minutes of my first day of exploring Mumbai. I saw Kanifnath Juice Centre and ordered their sugarcane juice. I've only ever had Vietnamese sugarcane juice, which I like very much. Kanifnath's sugarcane juice - which I now prefer - has a creamy quality to it and is less sweet. It's addictively delicious.

The service was very pleasant and quick. The juicer guy made crushing giant stalks of sugarcane look like child's play. The restaurant offers snacks and other refreshments too, but it seems their juices are their main attraction. I also visited this restaurant a few hours later to order a watermelon juice. Though I was too thirsty to take pictures, the watermelon juice was wonderfully refreshing.

I highly recommend this restaurant for all-natural juices that quickly quench your thirst.

featured_reviews.name: Runali Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited your outlet specifically for the "Waffle Anniversary" offer (13th/14th November) and endured a four-hour wait, from 8:00 PM until midnight, only to leave without a single waffle. The management's planning for this event was an absolute disaster, leading to total chaos and customer exhaustion.
There were only two staff members serving a massive crowd of people drawn by the promotion. These two boys were visibly overwhelmed, with no senior manager present to handle the unprecedented volume or crowd control. It was utter chaos.
The primary issue was the policy (or lack thereof) on purchase limits. Customers early in the line were allowed to buy excessive quantities (8-10 waffles per person), quickly draining resources and capacity. A four-waffle limit was finally announced after 9:00 PM, but the damage was already done. After four hours of waiting, the exhausted staff finally announced they were too tired to make any more waffles, and the line was shut down.
I do not blame the frontline staff—they were put in an impossible situation. I place the blame entirely on Keventers' management for running such a high-volume promotion without securing adequate staffing, proper crowd control measures, or a sensible purchase limit from the start. This was a clear bait-and-switch that wasted my time and ruined the experience for the at least 50 people waiting. A massive failure in logistics and customer service.

featured_reviews.name: DNB Travel & Food Reviews
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Visited Bunty Juice Center – One of the Most Famous Juice & Snack Spots in Borivali

Visited Bunty Juice Center in Borivali West and had a really enjoyable experience. This place is very popular for its huge variety of juices, shakes, desserts, sandwiches, and snacks with unique presentation style.

🍹 Food & Drinks:
The menu is extremely creative with interesting names and unique serving style. Must-try items include Gabbar Mango Shake, Kiwi Strawberry Juice, Chocolate Thali, Strawberry Cream, Festival Pizza, Chowpatty Sandwich, and Jungli Sandwich. Taste was fresh, flavorful, and presentation was eye-catching.

🍨 Desserts & Presentation:
Desserts and shakes are one of the biggest highlights here. The presentation is very different and trendy, which makes it fun especially for youngsters and families.

💰 Price:
Approx ₹250–₹500 per person depending on your order. Some items feel slightly premium priced, but quantity and creativity balance it well.

🏠 Ambience:
The place has colorful interiors, vibrant atmosphere, and cozy seating. It is usually crowded in evenings and weekends because of its popularity.

👨‍🍳 Staff & Service:
Staff is generally helpful and service is quick even during rush hours. They also guide properly if you are confused by the large menu.

🚗 Parking:
Parking can be difficult during peak time because the area gets crowded. Better to visit slightly early in evenings. They have Velvet parking facility too.

🧼 Cleanliness:
Overall cleanliness is decent considering the heavy crowd, though seating gets busy during peak hours.

📌 Overall:
Great place for juices, desserts, and innovative snacks with fun presentation. Perfect hangout spot for friends and family in Borivali.

Highly recommended 👍

Bunty Cafe is a charming establishment that offers both indoor air-conditioned seating and outdoor seating, allowing guests to enjoy their meals in a setting that suits their preference. One of the standout features of this cafe is its popular range of juices, which are served in a visually appealing and creative way. The presentation adds an extra touch to the overall experience, making it more enjoyable.

A particular highlight was the Chaupati Sandwich, which was full of flavor and left a lasting impression. However, the pasta was a bit of a disappointment. Instead of the expected pasta sauce, it had a taste resembling a paneer gravy, which was not quite what one would expect from a pasta dish.

For dessert, the Strawberry Cream was quite delightful, offering a nice balance of sweetness and freshness. Additionally, the cafe offers a variety of funky juices, each presented with a unique setup that adds to the overall appeal. Although the juice setups are quite fancy, the juices themselves are priced higher than expected, but they remain fairly average in terms of taste.

The ambience of the cafe is simple and unassuming, but it provides a comfortable space for conversations and casual hangouts. It's a great spot for a relaxed chit-chat with friends or family, making it an ideal place to spend time with loved ones over a refreshing drink.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Aundhakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you're looking for **fresh dairy products and refreshing juices** in Kandivali, **Shree Raghuvanshi Dairy Farm and Juice Corner** is a reliable and satisfying spot. Here's a detailed review based on my visit:

🥛 **Dairy Products (5/5):**
Their milk, paneer, shrikhand, and basundi are always fresh and of high quality. You can literally taste the richness of traditional dairy in every bite or sip. Paneer is soft, fresh, and ideal for cooking. Their **ghee** also has a homemade aroma and consistency. Perfect for daily use or festive cooking.

🍹 **Juices & Shakes (4/5):**
They serve a wide range of fresh fruit juices, milkshakes, and seasonal specials. I tried the **sitaphal milkshake** and **mango lassi** — both were thick, well-blended, and served chilled. You can expect authentic fruit flavors without artificial sweetness. Seasonal availability may vary, so ask the staff for the freshest options.

🧁 **Snacks & Sweets (4.5/5):**
They also offer **mithai** and **dairy-based sweets** like peda, gulab jamun, and shrikhand — fresh and reasonably priced. During festivals, the variety expands.

🧼 **Cleanliness & Hygiene (4/5):**
The shop is clean and well-organized. Counters and equipment are wiped down regularly. You can see them preparing juice in front of you, which builds trust. Hygiene is generally good, though the area outside can be crowded during peak hours.

👨‍🍳 **Staff & Service (4.5/5):**
Staff is polite, efficient, and knowledgeable about their products. Service is quick, and they offer suggestions if you're confused about options. Billing is smooth and they accept digital payments.

🚗 **Location & Parking (3.5/5):**
It’s located in a busy part of Kandivali, so **parking is a bit of a challenge**, especially in the evenings. Best to walk in or use a two-wheeler.

💰 **Value for Money (5/5):**
For the quality of products, the prices are very reasonable. It’s great to have a hygienic, trustworthy dairy and juice shop that doesn’t overcharge.

📍 **Overall Verdict:**
Whether you're buying paneer for your kitchen or craving a fresh fruit juice on a hot day, **Shree Raghuvanshi Dairy Farm and Juice Corner** is a go-to place in Kandivali. Consistently good quality, fast service, and fresh products make it stand out from the rest.

✅ **Highly recommended** for dairy lovers and juice fans alike!
